task.title: Migrate specification listing and category editor visuals
task.input: Existing /admin/specs SSR categoryMeta list, SpecEditor/specs.css and actual GET/PUT specification APIs.
task.output: Existing SSR category navigation and specification editor in the locked visual system, with unchanged business rules.
task.accept: 1) Actual ADMIN/EDITOR clicks Product specifications to /admin/specs; the SSR list comes from categoryMeta. Click an existing category to /admin/specs/[category] and GET /api/admin/specs/[category], then return through All categories. Unknown category and SALES retain original 404/403, with no new category or PDP. 2) Use the actual Save control to PUT original field names for English/Russian materials, dimensions, MOQ, lead time, fees and certifications. In an isolated synthetic record, subsequent GET matches the save; invalid fields preserve draft and visible associated errors. Do not remove fields or truncate necessary labels to pass density. Change only specs styles and necessary class/native semantics, consuming M1 components. Read 07/11/12 and only minimalist-flat. At 1920x1080, 1440x900 and 390x844 capture actual service GIFs, computed 2px border, zero radius, no shadow/gradient, accent #b45700, D1-D6/overflow and 44px targets. Listing is work, editor is left-aligned form, density7/gutter16/gap16/pad16; all loading/empty/error/success/disabled/focus states. E-109.
